# Amazon Web Services — AWS Activate

Tiered AWS credits: up to $5,000 USD for self-funded founders applying directly, and up to $200,000 USD for pre-Series B startups holding an Org ID from an Activate Provider.

| **Status** | Open - apply directly |

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $200,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Expiry** | The credits page does not state a validity period; it refers to the AWS Promotional Credit Terms & Conditions. https://aws.amazon.com/startups/credits/faq/ 301-redirects to https://startups.aws.com/credits/faq/, which returned 404, so expiry could not be confirmed. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Activate Founders (self-funded) | $5,000 | Up to $5,000 USD in Activate Credits | No partner needed |
| Activate Portfolio (pre-Series B) | $200,000 | You must have an Organization ID (Org ID) from your Activate Provider | A partner code is required |
| AWS Credits for AI Startups | $200,000 | $200,000+ in AWS Credits | A partner code is required |

### Not covered

- Series B and later startups
- startups founded more than 10 years ago

### Notes

Baseline eligibility quoted on the page: "Pre-series B, founded in the last 10 years, AWS Account on Paid Tier Plan, and either new to Activate or requesting more credits than previously received". The $200,000 Portfolio tier is partner-gated: "You must have an Organization ID (Org ID) from your Activate Provider". A third, invite-only band (AWS Credits for AI Startups, "$200,000+ in AWS Credits") sits above Activate Portfolio. NOT INSPECTABLE: credit validity/expiry period — the Activate credits FAQ URL now 404s, so duration_months is left null rather than guessed. Tiers are listed separately and deliberately not summed.
